description: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.
transcript: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!

en.question: What is the robot doing at first?

de.answer: Er nähert sich auf dem Weg der Kamera.

es.answer: Se está acercando a la cámara por el camino.
phrases: estar de pie sobre su pecho

fr.answer: Il s'approche de la caméra le long du chemin.
